title: Core odd filtration quotient calculation
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-derived-total-filtration-cokernel-odd, with an explicitly specified endpoint isomorphism rather than a Nonempty wrapper, the categorical cokernel of the odd stage inclusion is isomorphic to the reindexed coproduct of single-degree copies.

source.place: Tag 09KP, proof, alternating two-step column filtration

proof.text: Construct the canonical descended map from the shifted third endpoint to the odd categorical quotient; it is bijective in every degree by the odd quotient bijectivity theorem. A cochain map with isomorphic components is an isomorphism. Invert it, apply the shift functor to the specified endpoint isomorphism, use preservation of coproducts by the shift equivalence, and use the single-functor shift isomorphism on each summand to replace degree d by d-j.
